title: The own standards index has room for a new CI rule record
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-16, #1205: adding s-ci-ship-runtime for test/rules/ship-runtime.test.ts failed: render-standards-index throws 'the own standards index is 5998 bytes, over its 5800 byte budget' (index already 5776 bytes), so the rule test moved to test/cli/ to avoid test/brain/ci-rule-coverage.test.ts.
Outcome: `node scripts/render-standards-index.ts --write` exits 0 after adding one 200-byte CI rule record, because the index lines are shortened, retired records leave, or the budget is re-derived from what readers load.
Why: a full budget silently pushes guard tests out of test/rules, so CI-rule coverage erodes.
Proof: a fixture test adds a 200-byte record and the render exits 0 under the budget.
Files: src/brain/standards-index.ts, .agents/standards.json
